title: Orabella Banquet
imageAlt: Aerial view of Orabella Banquet grounds
paragraph1: Where sacred vows meet timeless luxury, where royal wedding dreams blossom amidst lush green serenity, cradled by elegance and regal Indian hospitality.
paragraph2: Nestled in Delhi, Orabella Banquet is the city's most prestigious venue for destination weddings, royal receptions, sangeet nights, and grand celebrations. Designed to host lavish gatherings of up to 1,500+ guests with complete peace of mind.
